## v0.8.5 — Seismograph

**Seismo** draws a vibration trace from the accelerometer. A sweep takes about 12 seconds. The footer shows the full scale and the peak of that sweep. Left and right change the scale (20 / 50 / 100 / 200 mg).

Firmware and Companion are both **0.8.5** (Companion versionCode 7). Companion behavior is unchanged.
